basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a 28-year-old consultant currently based in Austin, TX. I've always had a passion for travel and the outdoors, which led me to explore the idea of van life. During the week, I work remotely as a business analyst for a consulting firm, but my weekends are filled with hiking and exploring new places. I'm single, and my online hours typically range from 7 PM to 10 PM CST. I'm not a fan of overly crowded tourist spots and prefer discovering hidden gems. I'm new to Reddit, so I'm still learning the ropes here!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've got a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration and have been working in the consulting industry for about 5 years. Much of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience in project management and data analysis. Lately, I've been self-teaching myself about digital nomadism and remote work infrastructure, especially focusing on mobile internet solutions.
